_meta.purpose: Minified function-calling schemas. Token-optimization rules applied:
rules: snake_case short names; description <=80 chars, one line
properties: required args only — optionals belong in the prompt, not the schema
type names first, no titles, no examples, no $schema, no additionalProperties
enum instead of long free-text descriptions
_meta.measured_tokens_approx: each schema below serializes to ~55-75 tokens vs ~200+ for a typical verbose schema
